description.value:
Choose up to six droids or constructs within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each restores 3d8 plus your techcasting ability modifier hit points. This power affects only droids and constructs.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 6th level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 per slot level beyond 5th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 5
